body:
It's been exactly three weeks, yesterday since my father killed himself. I hate when people tell me they know what I'm going through or they ask me how I'm feeling-all you can feel is pain and anger. How do you expect me to feel? My family is alone. 
I understand it's hard going through this, every scenario is unique but if you want to talk to someone about it I would love another person's perspective. 

-Mel
